$description: Web Push payloads for the Lading redesign (Norwegian). Sent as JSON by src/lib/push/send.ts and read by public/sw.js. Keep body under ~60 characters. 'tag' groups notifications per plan/session so a new one replaces the previous. 'actions' only render on Android/Chrome; iOS opens 'url' on tap.

events.trigger: Plug-in observed (Disconnected → connected) and no pending plan for the charger

payload.title: Bilen er koblet til
payload.body: Batteri {percent} % (målt {time}). Trykk for å planlegge lading.

events.trigger: Plug-in observed and a pending plan exists

payload.title: Bilen er koblet til
payload.body: Planen er klar – lading starter ca. {startTime}.

events.trigger: Plug-in observed, on_plugin_mode = smart, no user plan; sent once the planner has made blocks

payload.title: Bilen er klar
payload.body: Ladet til ca. {targetPercent} % · {kwh} kWh · ca. {cost} kr.

events.trigger: While charging for a plan, estimated finish passes readyBy (send once per plan)

payload.title: Rekker ikke helt
payload.body: Bilen blir ca. {expectedPercent} % klar {readyBy}. Vi lader videre til {targetPercent} %.

events.trigger: Pending plan, car not connected, now >= latestStartTime − 30 min (send once per plan)

payload.title: Planen venter på bilen
payload.body: Koble til innen {latestStart} for å være klar {readyBy}.

events.status: decided (D75), level: car declined (Lad nå, case 1)
events.trigger: Lad nå open; car stopped drawing (mode 5 at once, or 2 min with no power) and battery >= 95 % or >= last plan target. Max one Lad nå push per session.

events.status: decided (D75), level: car declined (Lad nå, case 2, and case 3 after 30 min)
events.trigger: Lad nå open; car stopped drawing below full after energy came in. Idle (mode 3, 0 A) only after 30 min. Max one Lad nå push per session.

payload.title: Bilen sluttet å lade
payload.body: Stoppet ved {percent} %. Sjekk ladegrensen eller timeren i bilen.

events.status: decided (D75), level: car declined (Lad nå, case 4)
events.trigger: Lad nå open; 0 kWh delivered and no power for 5 min since start. Max one Lad nå push per session.

payload.title: Bilen lader ikke
payload.body: Ingen strøm etter {minutes} min. Sjekk kabelen og bilens timer.

events.trigger: A plan or Smart lading inside its window, or an automatic session; the car stopped drawing (mode 5 at once, or 2 min with no power) before the target. Not when the target is reached. One push per incident.

payload.title: Bilen sluttet å lade
payload.body: Stoppet ved {percent} %, før målet. Sjekk bilens ladegrense eller timer.

events.status: decided (D75), level: fault – replaces the D64 'won't start' copy
events.trigger: Charging was asked for and the charger did not carry out the start after the app's tries (D64). One push per incident.

payload.title: Ladingen stoppet
payload.body: Laderen startet ikke kl. {time}. Sjekk laderen, eller prøv igjen i appen.

events.trigger: Charging was asked for (or a plan window is open) and the charger has been offline for 10 min. One push per incident; 'Laderen er tilbake' is an activity line, not a push.

payload.title: Laderen svarer ikke
payload.body: Ingen kontakt siden {time}. Bilen lader ikke.

events.status: decided (D75), level: fault – replaces the D65 loop-guard copy
events.trigger: Zaptec's 'stopped too many times' lock, or the app's loop guard trips (D64/D65). One push per incident.

payload.title: Laderen stoppet for mange ganger
payload.body: Koble bilen fra og til igjen for å lade.

events.trigger: A D73 charger warning appears while charging was asked for. One push per incident.

neverNotify: manual start/stop (the person doing it already knows)
manual Lad nå / Forvarm / Stopp to the other devices either (owner answered Q14: no, 2026-11-13)

incidentRules.family: Fault titles name the charger or the charging ('Laderen …', 'Ladingen stoppet'). Car-declined titles start with 'Bilen …' (Forvarm on battery keeps 'Forvarming bruker batteriet', D68). Body = what happened + one thing to do.
incidentRules.onePerIncident: An incident opens on the first warning and closes when it clears. Save the notified flag before sending (as D65/D68). A new incident needs charging to have resumed or a new request in between.
incidentRules.recipients: Every subscribed device in the household (both phones). Manual taps never notify anyone, not even the other devices (Q14: no).
